=== sw-code / swcode ===

observation.command: cd /workspace/backend && echo "=== All external dependency coordinates (group:artifact) across backend ==="; grep -rhoE "(implementation|api|compileOnly|runtimeOnly|testImplementation|testRuntimeOnly)\s*\(\s*\"[^\"]+\"" --include="*.kts" . 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "\"[^\"]+\"" | tr -d '"' | sort -u > /tmp/dep_all.txt; wc -l /tmp/dep_all.txt; echo "=== io.swcode deps (potential GitHub Packages) ==="; grep "io.swcode" /tmp/dep_all.txt; echo "=== sw-code / swcode ==="; grep -iE "sw-code|swcode" /tmp/dep_all.txt
